name: Rooster
description: On a college campus, an author navigates a complicated relationship with his daughter.

videos.title: Release the Brown Fat
videos.overview: Writer Greg Russo arrives at Ludlow College to support his daughter Katie as her marriage begins to implode.

videos.title: Trousers
videos.overview: When Katie's future at Ludlow is thrown into question, Walt offers Greg a deal to keep them both on campus.

videos.title: White Whale
videos.overview: While Greg endures his first day of teaching at Ludlow, Katie struggles with her suspension. Later, Archie decides to help Sunny find a suitable advisor, and Dylan is presented with an unexpected new opportunity.

videos.title: Angry, Like an Angry Person
videos.overview: To avoid Walt's party, Greg throws himself into helping a student. With her suspension lifted, Katie contemplates casual dating.

videos.title: Mr. Razzles
videos.overview: When his ex-wife Beth shows up for a dedication ceremony on campus, Greg starts to backslide into old habits. Later, Katie reconnects with Archie, and Dylan finds herself flourishing in her new role.

videos.title: Cop Hawk
videos.overview: While relishing in his new fling, Greg offers a struggling Tommy a place to crash. Later, Katie confronts the student behind some personal campus graffiti, Dylan impresses Walt in her new role, and Sunny wrestles with a prestigious job offer.

videos.title: All the Dogs' Names
videos.overview: Greg, Cristle, and Tommy attempt a return to normalcy after an embarrassing mishap. Meanwhile, Archie meets Sunny's father, Walt offers Dylan a new position following Dean Riggs' return, and Katie deals with her evolving feelings for Archie.

videos.title: Nobody Spook It
videos.overview: While Greg tries to support an increasingly emotional Katie, Dylan attempts to steer a promising student towards poetry. Later, Sunny is delighted when Archie starts to engage more with her pregnancy.

videos.title: Ludlow's Fourth Hottest Professor
videos.overview: Thriving in and out of the classroom, Greg empowers the hockey team before a key game. Meanwhile, Archie receives feedback on his book and Katie focuses on getting tenure – which reveals the extent of her parents' involvement in her life.

videos.title: Songs for Raisa
videos.overview: After setting boundaries with her parents, Katie makes a decision about her marriage to Archie – who has his own talk with Sunny about the future. Then, as he grapples with Katie's independence, Greg prepares to say goodbye to his semester at Ludlow.
